description: This file is a React component for displaying and editing synchronization configuration settings via a modal dialog. It includes UI elements such as buttons, selectors, switches, and inputs for configuring synchronization providers, proxy settings, and provider-specific options.

methods.name: CheckButton
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a button to check cloud sync status, displaying different icons based on the current check state.

methods.name: check
methods.description: An asynchronous function within CheckButton that triggers a sync store check and updates the check state accordingly.
